standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the limit of nonempty quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces over a cofiltered category is nonempty

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the constructible topology of a spectral space is quasi-compact Hausdorff, and that spectral maps are continuous for it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 5040-5044)
standard_prerequisites.use: Puts the inverse system in the setting of the previous nonemptiness result.

core_obligations: Change topology: each space is quasi-compact Hausdorff in the constructible topology and the transition maps are spectral hence continuous there, and the closedness of the images makes the limit in the constructible topologies nonempty (proof lines 5039-5047)
Compare the two limits: the underlying set of the limit computed in the constructible topologies is the same as the underlying set of the original limit (proof lines 5048-5049)
proof_roadmap: 把每个 X_i 换成其可构造拓扑：由谱性它们准紧 Hausdorff，转移映射谱 ⇒ 连续；像闭 ⇒ 满足 nonempty-limit 的条件 ⇒ 该系统的极限非空。
可构造拓扑下的极限的底层点集与原有极限的底层点集相同 ⇒ 原极限非空。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a cofiltered limit of nonempty spectral spaces whose transition maps have closed images is nonempty (author lemma at source lines 5026-5037, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-nonempty). The proof (source lines 5039-5050) replaces each space by its constructible topology, where the hypotheses of the nonemptiness result for quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces apply, and observes that the two limits have the same underlying set (proof lines 5039-5049). The change of topology is the substance. H3.
